description: Outside-the-log mean-positive supervised contrastive objective with L2-normalized view embeddings, self-pair exclusion, and same-label positives (Khosla et al., §3.1 and §3.2.2, Eq. (2)); Trainer bindings use src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def paired_views(ctx):
    label = int(ctx.index) % 2
    center = torch.zeros(6)
    center[label] = 1.0
    first = center + 0.05 * torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    second = center + 0.05 * torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(torch.stack((first, second))), "targets": label}
dataset = synth.Spec("supcon-paired-views", generator=paired_views, size=16, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
class Projector(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.network = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=8)
    def forward(self, inputs):
        batch_size, view_count, feature_count = inputs.shape
        flat = inputs.reshape(batch_size * view_count, feature_count)
        embeddings = self.network(flat).reshape(batch_size, view_count, -1)
        return {"embeddings": embeddings}
trainer = Trainer(Projector(), train, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "supcon", "loss_kwargs": {"temperature": 0.1}, "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "embeddings"}, "targets": {"batch": "targets"}}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train an encoder with supervised contrastive loss

name: Supervised contrastive loss

parameters.ignore_index: must be None because the SupCon formulation does not define ignored labels
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point projection embeddings shaped [B,V,D] with B >= 1, V >= 2, and D >= 1; embeddings are L2-normalized inside the loss
parameters.reduction: none returns losses for each of the B*V anchors, mean averages anchors, or sum totals anchors (default mean)
parameters.targets: class labels shaped [B], represented by integer tensors or integral-valued floating tensors from structured-objective batches
parameters.temperature: finite positive scalar divisor for normalized pairwise dot products (default 0.1)
